name: issue-resolver/trivial-bug
prompt: Fix the always-false login bug; prove red→green; open a conforming PR

grade.label: branch name from subject artifact passes idd-lint
commit message from subject artifact passes idd-lint
PR body passes idd-lint (Closes + DR + AC + Reproduction)
red→green evidence has exact test exit values
closing block states result, evidence, uncertainty, and decision

criteria: The first report line states DONE and names issue #1 without reading the tracker or logs.
Observed checks (red→green test exits, the gh pr create URL, the run-log record) are separate from the risk judgment and the checks this stand-in did not run.
Each test claim names its exit values, the PR claim names its URL, and nothing claims the PR was merged.
The report says No approval needed and names /issue-pr-review as the next action.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests a report fixture, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
